claimed_scope: Build the minimal typed binding from workpackage -> parent Agent tool-use/delegation -> explicitly derived child causal identity -> returned result identity/digest. This package binds identities only. It does not implement recipient delivery/ACK/dedupe (F2-WP-103), deferred return transport (F2-WP-104), execution/completion semantics (F2-WP-105), Native Child ABI/runtime/spawn policy (F2-WP-601+), UnifiedDB writes, effects, or runtime execution.
non_overlap_note: A refreshed exact-head claim inventory contained no F2-WP-102 claim. F2-WP-100, F2-WP-101 and F2-WP-103 already had parallel claims and are left untouched.
binding_invariants: workpackage_id, tool_use_id, delegation_id and result_id are explicit non-empty identities, never inferred from time/process context
child identity must explicitly name the parent causal_id through parent_causal_id
child generation must be greater than parent generation for a delegated child
child session_id remains equal to the parent session_id in this binding layer; transport/session bridging belongs elsewhere
result identity is bound to exactly one delegation and exactly one child causal identity
terminal result records require a lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest; pending records carry neither result_id nor digest
binding serialization is deterministic and unknown/malformed fields fail closed
acceptance_target: typed source primitive binds workpackage, parent identity, tool-use, delegation and child identity
result binding cannot be silently attached to the wrong delegation/child identity
validation rejects non-descendant child identities, non-incremented generations and malformed result digests
local deterministic unit tests cover positive and fail-closed cases
source/local component evidence does not mint runtime or whole-system credit
